elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Item A.1 requires CGL with "primary limits of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000)" but does not state the basis (per occurrence vs. aggregate), so a per-occurrence floor cannot be confirmed literally.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: The same single "primary limits" figure of $2,000,000 is undesignated; no aggregate limit is expressed anywhere in 14.1(A).

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The inserted sentence sets E&O at "not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000)" — below the preferred USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted cyber/privacy limit is "not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000)", below the preferred USD 5,000,000 for a vendor processing Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: Retained A.3: "Workers' Compensation Insurance as mandated or allowed by the state in which the Services are being performed", plus $500,000 employer's liability.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: Retained 14.1(B): "at Customer's request, M&I shall deliver to Customer original Certificates of Insurance evidencing the coverage required by this Section."

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted under the 14.1(A) lead-in obligation ("M&I shall maintain at all times at its own cost and expense"): "Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance in an amount not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000)".

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Same inserted sentence: "Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance in an amount not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000)", carried by the same mandatory lead-in.

reasons: Fallback is position-complete: both E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000 appear in operative language governed by the mandatory 14.1(A) lead-in, and neither exceeds the fallback threshold.

Preferred is not complete: E&O ($1M vs $2M) and cyber ($2M vs $5M) are below preferred limits, and the retained CGL figure is a single undesignated "primary limits" amount rather than the required per-occurrence/aggregate split.

Minimal: the redline adds only the two missing coverages, adds no survival tail, no duplicate "at its own expense" wording (already in the lead-in), no certificate or procedure language (existing 14.1(B) mechanic already covers "the coverage required by this Section"), and deletes nothing from the existing schedule.

Preserves intent: existing CGL, fidelity, workers' compensation and all-risk property coverages, the A-rated carrier requirement, the 30-day cancellation notice and the annual certificate delivery all survive without contradiction; no undefined term or dangling cross-reference is created.
Drafting nit (not a defect in operative effect): the inserted sentence is unnumbered while the surrounding items are numbered 1-4; number it "5." for clean integration into the schedule.
